static_traits.name: 迪安娜
static_traits.educational_background: 就读私立High school并修读大学学分课程
static_traits.family_status: Both parents have heavy European accents
static_traits.social_status: 有一些朋友，但因奖学金申请与担忧而Reduced socializing、趋于自我隔离
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著身体疾病
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, logic fairly good, tone rather negative; catastrophizing predictions and overgeneralization exist; skeptical about suggestions but can consider small-step attempts, cooperativeness acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: 我认为由于父母为私立High school支付高额学费，我not会获得大学奖学金。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling when these thoughts began to affect my motivation to apply for scholarships and plan for college.

core_beliefs: 我not可能获得大学奖学金

special_situations.event: 在Researching university options and financial-aid information时，注意到私立High school学费很高
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果父母已为我的私立High school支付高额学费，那么我将not具备获得大学奖学金的资格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or delays scholarship applications, worries excessively and repeatedly looks up information to try to gain certainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not会有资格得到奖学金

special_situations.event: When starting to seriously plan college and scholarship applications
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能保证一定拿到奖学金，那投入规划和申请就have not意义
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not保证就do not浪费时间

special_situations.event: When friends think I am 'overreacting' to the scholarship issue and find it hard to understand my worries
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人not认同或not理解我的Anxiety，我就必须与他们疏离、独自承担压力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids communicating with friends, socially isolated, putting all energy into applications
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not理解我，我只能自己扛

special_situations.event: Situations of worrying that the schedule will be disrupted by sudden tasks, thus falling behind the application progress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once any interruption occurs, I will miss the opportunity and fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Skeptical of new strategies, avoids trying, and continues over-managing and worrying
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If the plan is disrupted, I will fail

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stable support and recognition (achieving acceptance and funding through the scholarship)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、without法负担大学从而前途受限
defense_goal: 通过降低期望与回避申请来减少Being rejected的痛苦
通过过度关注not确定性维持控制感

object_relations.self_representation: Loneliness而压力巨大的申请者，Decreased drive、需要自己扛
object_relations.object_representation: not理解自己压力的他人（如朋友）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes trying a new time arrangement or behavioral experiment to balance applications and socializing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将“have not保证”理解为“not可行”，以理性化的方式回避尝试（移情：将not确定等同于失败）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎与怀疑，强调not确定性和缺乏保证，以逻辑理由推迟或negate尝试

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing talking with friends about academic and financial worries or obtaining support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人not会理解或只会negate自己，于是将寻求支持的冲动转而对自己施压（移情：期待被忽视）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoids asking for support, emphasizes 'I will bear it myself', reduces emotional expression, and instead doubles down on doing application tasks alone

manifestations: 为专注奖学金申请而减少与朋友相处，避免谈及学业与财务担忧，感到“真的很Loneliness”
在面对not确定性时希望有“保证”，对自我选择与负责感到Anxiety，担心错过机会
outcomes: Excessive control and planning disrupting daily routines

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Insists on guarantees before daring to try
Highly cautious and skeptical about time-scheduling strategies

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Avoiding discussing academic and financial worries with friends
Turning the need to seek support into self-pressure and completing the application alone

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 以“have not保证”为理由回避直接尝试新的行为策略
通过泛化与预测not yet来来避免面对当下的申请行动

positive_force: 学业表现Good，具备一定的学习与自我管理能力
Has a few friends they can reach out to
negative_force: 灾难化预测与仓促下结论（预测not yet来）
Excessive worry about college finances, routines disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively worries about college finances and scholarships; repeatedly looks up information
antecedent: Researching university options and financial-aid information
When starting to consider college and scholarships
target_behavior.core_reason: 对“without法获得奖学金”的灾难化预测与过度概括
target_behavior.function: 试图获得确定性与控制感，以缓解not确定性带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 日常作息被打乱、压力加剧、Decreased drive

antecedent: When preparing or submitting scholarship application materials
When facing the application process and deadlines
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-doubt与对Being rejected的恐惧（由过度概括与预测not yet来驱动）
target_behavior.function: Escaping the pain of failure and rejection
target_behavior.consequence: Application progress blocked, may miss the opportunity

target_behavior.behavior: Social isolation, less time with friends
antecedent: When friends question the worry or think the reaction is excessive
When needing to discuss academic and financial issues with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: 认为他人not理解自己、寻求外部验证失败后转向自我承担
target_behavior.function: Escapes evaluation and conflict, maintains a fragile sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Increased sense of loneliness，Reduced social support，压力与Anxiety worsened
